notes: Oxfordshire County Council is the council fostering service for Oxford; its own fostering support page says its central recruitment team is based at Knights Court, Oxford, and lists Oxford first among its team bases.
Fitzgerald Fostering's own Oxford page says it aims to provide foster placements for children in Oxford and the surrounding areas (agency based in Bracknell, Berkshire).
Fostering UK's own Oxfordshire page asks people living in Oxford, Banbury, Bicester, Abingdon, Witney and other named towns to foster with it.

Fostering Hearts' own Oxfordshire 'areas we cover' page names Oxford and communities across Oxfordshire north of the M4 as its area. Oxfordshire as a whole is not added, as the page limits cover to north of the M4.

Apex Fostering's own Cambridgeshire page says it supports people across the county including Cambridge, Ely, Huntingdon and St Neots. Watford: see second source. Its own Hertfordshire page says it supports carers across Hertfordshire including St Albans, Watford and Stevenage.

To the Moon and Back's own Cambridgeshire page names Cambridge among its recruitment areas and says its office is in Kings Hedges, Cambridge. Watford: see second source. Its own Hertfordshire page says it is looking for foster carers in Hemel Hempstead, Stevenage, Watford and St Albans.
Soundly Fostering's own locations page says it supports carers in Cambridge, Ely, Huntingdon, Peterborough and nearby communities.
Mosaic Foster Care's own Hertfordshire page invites people who live in Watford, St Albans, Hemel Hempstead, Stevenage or Hertford to foster with it.
Family Works Fostering's own Hertfordshire page names Watford, St Albans, Stevenage and Hemel Hempstead as places it recruits carers for children in need.
Sunbeam's own Hertfordshire recruitment page says it is recruiting in Hertfordshire and surrounding areas including Watford, St Albans and Stevenage.
ISP's own Hertfordshire page, served from its Chesham office, lists Watford among the cities and areas it covers.
